summary: Ansible-base 2.10.0 briefly changed the default mode of file-based tasks to 0600 & ~umask, reverted in 2.10.1 to 0666 & ~umask; set mode explicitly to address CVE-2020-1736. From 2.10.1, dnf/yum validate GPG signatures properly (CVE-2020-14365), so import the right key with rpm_key or, as a last resort, set disable_gpg_check.
questions: Why did my files get 0600 permissions with ansible-base 2.10.0?
dnf fails with 'Failed to validate GPG signature', how do I fix it?
What file mode does copy use when I don't set mode?
How do I avoid CVE-2020-1736 in my playbooks?

answer_card.title: Default file mode and dnf GPG checks in 2.10
answer_card.answer_md:
**File mode**: 2.10.0 defaulted file tasks to `0600 & ~umask`; **2.10.1 reverted** to `0666 & ~umask`. To avoid CVE-2020-1736, always set `mode:` on file-based tasks.

**dnf/yum GPG**: since 2.10.1 signatures are really validated (CVE-2020-14365). On `Failed to validate GPG signature for <pkg>`, import the key:

```yaml
- ansible.builtin.rpm_key:
    key: https://example.com/RPM-GPG-KEY
```

Only if unavoidable: `disable_gpg_check: true`.
